Germany and Portugal meet in the semi-final of the UEFA Nations League with the winner of this tie taking on either Spain or France, who contest their semi-final on Thursday.
[...]
Germany have been on an upward trajectory under the tutelage of Julian Nagelsmann, they remained unbeaten during the group stage of the competition and then saw off Italy over two legs in the quarter-final to reach this stage.
[...]
Portugal posted the exact same record as Germany during the group stages (W4, D2), but have faced more challenges under Roberto Martinez, who is yet to find the right formula for this talented Portugal side. They had to overturn a 1-0 defeat to Denmark in the first leg of the quarter-finals to reach this stage of the tournament.

## 📊 Germany v Portugal Form and Tactics
[...]
Germany look really strong under Julian Nagelsmann, with them taking the Nations League as an opportunity to experiment with different personnel and systems. Jamal Musiala is usually an important part of this setup up, but as he is injured, expect some more tinkering from the former Bayern Munich and RB Leipzig manager.
[...]
Germany lined up in a 3-4-3 shape in their most recent Nations League outing against Italy. Joshua Kimmich’s versatility as a wing back was crucial in this game, with the 30-year-old picking up a goal and two assists, drifting inside from the right wing back position to create an overload in central areas.
[...]
The talent of this Portuguese side is undeniable and that alone should put them in a good position to go deep into the World Cup next year, but they will have to find something extra in the big games, something that’s been missing so far under Roberto Martinez and the Nations League can act as the perfect litmus test to see if they can go toe-to-toe with their European heavyweight rivals.
[...]
Portugal lined up in a 4-3-3 in their 5-2 win over Denmark in their most recent Nations League outing. They had 11 shots on target and generated an xG of 3.33, so the attacking quality of the side is undeniable. However, they let Denmark generate an xG of 1.9,8 which would suggest that their defence is still far from secure.
[...]
It’s worth noting that Germany have won the last four head-to-head meetings against Portugal. These records aren’t as relevant in international football as they are in club football, as the meetings are quite far apar,t but Germany are also unbeaten since their European Championship defeat to Spain last summer, giving them the slight edge in this encounter.

results.title: Germany 2026 World Cup preview: Squad, fixtures and prediction | Can Julian Nagelsmann's side reverse recent history? - Sports Mole
highlights:
Germany are in Group E of the
[...]
026 World Cup
[...]
As a Pot 1 nation ranked 10th in the world, Germany are positioned in a bracket that - should they win Group E and other top seeds also win their groups - would keep old foes France at arm's length until the last 16.

showdown with Les Bleus.
[...]
Then, the Netherlands could await in a potential quarter-final, before a possible semi-final clash against Spain.
[...]
However, finishing second in Group E would seriously complicate that picture, particularly as Nagelsmann's men might have to beat either Norway or Senegal before reaching France.
[...]
Of course, finishing third is even more precarious: only eight of the 12 third-placed teams progress. So, yet another group-stage elimination then becomes a very real prospect.
[...]
Best case Win Group E, defeat Paraguay in the last 32, beat France in the last 16, then the Netherlands in the quarter-finals. Conquer Spain in a semi before the final takes place in New Jersey.
[...]
Worst case Finish second in Group E and lose bracket protection, facing a group runner-up in the last 32. Finish third and Germany must also be one of the eight best third-placed teams just to reach the knockout phase.
[...]
## Germany 2026 World Cup prediction
[...]
Group E should present few serious difficulties: Curacao on June 14 is an ideal opener, and Ecuador's modest tally of 14 goals from 18 qualifiers reflects a team built not to concede rather than threaten Germany's defence.
[...]
Ivory Coast could prove tricky opponents in Toronto, but a recent sequence of nine wins from 10 makes Die Nationalelf clear favourites to finish first.
[...]
Assuming they progress through a subsequent last-32 tie, the prospect of facing France in the last 16 looms large; yet victory there could set the Germans alight.
[...]
Given their potential opposition, even reaching the quarter-finals would represent a minor achievement, but Germany boast enough creativity to beat most teams in the tournament.
[...]
Actually winning a World Cup requires a consistent level that Nagelsmann's side has yet to demonstrate in the biggest moments, so we expect them to fall short of a fifth global crown.
[...]
Germany are priced at 14/1 with leading bookmakers as of June 2, 2026, making them the seventh-favourite for the tournament. The Opta supercomputer gives them a 96.4% chance of qualifying from Group E and a 59.9% probability of topping it. Their most likely knockout route involves France in the round of 16, the Netherlands in the quarter-final and Spain in the semi-final. Sports Mole predicts a quarter-final exit, with a semi-final possible if the Wirtz-Musiala partnership produces consistently in knockout football.

highlights:
Drawn into a highly favorable group alongside Curacao, Ivory Coast, and Ecuador, Germany enters the 2026 World Cup looking to erase the failures of consecutive group-stage exits and reestablish its status as an international powerhouse.

Germany averaged 66.7% possession and maintained a 90% passing accuracy, scoring 16 goals while conceding just three across six matches. Defensively, they recorded four clean sheets during that span. ## Germany World Cup Prediction
[...]
Germany, facing Curacao, Ivory Coast, and Ecuador, should comfortably navigate the opening phase. The data suggests a 65.4% probability of winning the group, and anything less than seven points would be a massive disappointment. With a 90% passing accuracy and an average of 2.67 goals per game during qualifiers, their offensive floor is extremely high against lower-tier opposition.
[...]
However, their defensive vulnerabilities against elite counter-attacking sides make a deep championship run difficult. A quarterfinal exit appears to be the most realistic outcome for a team still rebuilding its identity. From a betting perspective, value may lie in backing them to win their group, but fading them against top-tier favorites in the knockout stages.
